models.name: diabetes
models.details: A machine learning model that estimates the likelihood of an individual having diabetes based on demographic and body composition indicators. The model uses age and Body Mass Index (BMI) as predictors and returns a risk score or probability of diabetes.

models.name: cardio_disease
models.details: A cardiovascular disease risk prediction model that estimates the probability of heart-related conditions. It considers age, smoking status, alcohol consumption, physical activity level, BMI, and gender-related features to generate a risk assessment.

models.name: hypertension
models.details: A machine learning model designed to predict the likelihood of hypertension (high blood pressure). The model evaluates demographic and lifestyle factors, including age, BMI, smoking status, and gender, to estimate hypertension risk.

models.name: obesity
models.details: An obesity risk assessment model that predicts the likelihood of obesity based on demographic, lifestyle, and dietary habits. Factors such as BMI, physical activity, smoking, alcohol consumption, water intake, meal frequency, and caloric food consumption are used to estimate obesity risk.

models.name: cancer
models.details: A generalized cancer risk prediction model that estimates the probability of an individual belonging to a higher-risk category for cancer based on demographic and lifestyle-related factors. Inputs include age, BMI, smoking status, alcohol consumption, physical activity, and gender-related features.

age.description: Age of the individual in years

smoke.description: Whether the individual is a smoker

active.description: Whether the individual is physically active
